text: 2026年10月14日至16日，中国人民银行行长潘功胜在出席国际货币基金组织/世界银行年会期间，分别会见了泰国央行行长威泰、印尼央行行长德斯特里、马来西亚央行行长拉希德、印度央行行长马尔霍特拉、澳大利亚央行行长布洛克、土耳其央行行长卡拉汉、埃及央行行长阿卜杜拉、尼日利亚央行行长卡多索、格鲁吉亚央行行长特尔纳瓦等相关国家央行行长，就全球经济形势、深化双边务实金融合作等议题交换了意见。中国人民银行副行长宣昌能参加会见。（中国央行网站）
text_en: From October 14 to 16, 2026, during his attendance at the IMF/World Bank Annual Meetings, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng met separately with Bank of Thailand Governor Vitai, Bank Indonesia Governor Destry, Bank Negara Malaysia Governor Rasheed, Reserve Bank of India Governor Malhotra, Reserve Bank of Australia Governor Bullock, Central Bank of Turkey Governor Karahan, Central Bank of Egypt Governor Abdallah, Central Bank of Nigeria Governor Cardoso, National Bank of Georgia Governor Turnava and other central bank governors of relevant countries, and exchanged views on topics including the global economic situation and deepening bilateral practical financial cooperation. PBOC Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng attended the meetings. (PBOC website)
